name: DBMS
description: Relational algebra, SQL, normalization (1NF-BCNF), ACID properties, and indexing.

questions.prompt: Which normal form eliminates transitive functional dependencies for non-prime attributes?
questions.explanation: 3NF requires 2NF and mandates that no non-prime attribute is transitively dependent on the primary key.

questions.prompt: In database transaction management, what does the "Isolation" property guarantee?
options: Concurrent transactions execute without uncommitted interference
questions.explanation: Isolation ensures concurrent execution leaves the database in the same state as if transactions ran serially.
